scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n go2rtc,server,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run go2rtc" "npm -w server run dev" "npm -w web run dev"
scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -k -n go2rtc,server -c magenta,blue "npm run go2rtc" "npm -w server start"
scripts.typecheck: npm -w server run typecheck && npm -w web run typecheck
